title: PopperOptions Props
description: Properties of Popper that can be used to customize its behavior.

animationDuration.description: The duration of the CSS fade transition animation.

appendTo.description: The container to append the popper to. Defaults to 'inline'.

distance.description: Distance of the popper to the trigger

enableFlip.description: Enable to flip the popper when it reaches the boundary

entryDelay.description: Delay in ms before the popper appears

exitDelay.description: Delay in ms before the popper disappears

flipBehavior.description: The behavior of how the popper flips when it reaches the boundary

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the popper. If the value is "trigger", it will set the max width to the trigger element's width

minWidth.description: Minimum width of the popper. If the value is "trigger", it will set the min width to the trigger element's width

offset.description: Override for the popper's offset (Type: OffsetOptions['offset'])

onBlur.description: Callback function when trigger is blurred (focus leaves) (Function: (event?: FocusEvent) => void)

onDocumentClick.description: Callback function when document is clicked (Function: (event?: MouseEvent, triggerElement?: HTMLElement, popperElement?: HTMLElement) => void)

onDocumentKeyDown.description: Callback function when keydown event occurs on document (Function: (event?: KeyboardEvent) => void)

onFocus.description: Callback function when trigger is focused (Function: (event?: FocusEvent) => void)

onHidden.description: Callback when popper's hide transition has finished executing (Function: () => void)

onHide.description: Lifecycle function invoked when the popper begins to transition out. (Function: () => void)

onMount.description: Lifecycle function invoked when the popper has been mounted to the DOM. (Function: () => void)

onMouseEnter.description: Callback function when mouse enters trigger (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onMouseLeave.description: Callback function when mouse leaves trigger (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onPopperClick.description: Callback function when popper is clicked (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onPopperMouseEnter.description: Callback function when mouse enters popper content (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onPopperMouseLeave.description: Callback function when mouse leaves popper content (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onShow.description: Lifecycle function invoked when the popper begins to transition in. (Function: () => void)

onShown.description: Lifecycle function invoked when the popper has fully transitioned in. (Function: () => void)

onTriggerClick.description: Callback function when trigger is clicked (Function: (event?: MouseEvent) => void)

onTriggerEnter.description: Callback function when Enter key is used on trigger (Function: (event?: KeyboardEvent) => void)

placement.description: Instead of direction and position can set the placement of the popper (Type: Placement)

position.description: Horizontal position of the popper. Use the additional prop preventOverflow if seeing clipping.

preventOverflow.description: Flag to prevent the popper from overflowing its container and becoming partially obscured.

width.description: Custom width of the popper. If the value is "trigger", it will set the width to the trigger element's width
